name: Global View Co., Ltd.
summary: Established in 1986, Global View Co., Ltd. is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan. The company's core operations involve the manufacturing and marketing of electronic dictionary devices, catering to markets in both Taiwan and Mainland China. Its electronic dictionary offerings are sold under the distinct brand names Wenquxing and Harbin. Additionally, Global View Co., Ltd. also maintains an active property leasing business.
